item.title: Clayface, 2026 - ★★★★ (contains spoilers)
item.description:
This review may contain spoilers.

so...I LOVED IT!!!! Mike Flanagan SIR TAKE A BREAK, what a year he's having !!
I just WISH i could've seen the gore a bit more- it was censored ALOT by cbfc. the club scene was BANGER. the colours, the editing, the cinematography are top notch DC- some colours gave me flashbacks to Snyder's DCEU. i think snyder cuts and the flanagan movies have a very steely blue, metallic, blood red aesthetic- two of my fav directors of ALL time. also also GREAT use of beggin by madcon (s/o to Adam Sandler's Just Go with It). I think this movie will grow on me as I rewatch it- but I'm really excited to see James Gunn's DCU culminate into smth really explosive- the three movies have been really promising- I hope the next don't disappoint.

item.title: East of Eden, 2026 - ★★★★★
item.description:
FLORENCEEEE !!!!!! YOU'RE INSANE.
Joseph Zada, you are unmatched.
Christopher Abbott and Mike Faist have got rangeeeee for dayssss. Hoon Lee provides the kind of stability that the plot craves.
This was such an experience; so captivating, so gruesome, so real, so coherent. The kind of show that stays with you and makes you wonder. Human nature is so violent and ancestry so vulnerable- thus to observe the culmination of the two making or breaking a person- was surreal to watch. Idk how it was possible to adapt such a controversial book and make it more reachable- but somehow it worked beyond my expectations.
item.dc:creator: annie's film diary 📽️🍿

item.title: Unabomber, 2026 - ★★★½
item.description:
im attracted to movies like this one because 'dissection of the psyche and past trauma of a serial killer' is my fav genre- and im bored of cliche- overachieving but disturbed detective tracks down the killer- kinda stories. one of the reasons Mindhunter is truly THE goat.
I just feel like the plot structure could've been a bit different in this movie. But overall solid acting performances- Jacob Tremblay is so so so underrated.
